from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
import json,pandas as pd
root=Path.cwd(); b=root/"reports/research/510300_service_construction_demand_cause_increment_v1"
def save(name,obj):
 f=b/name
 assert not f.exists(),"已有对象不覆盖："+name
 f.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
m=json.loads((b/"result.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
d=pd.read_csv(b/"全部13主期机会_原端点费用与叶解释.csv",encoding="utf-8-sig")
all_events=pd.read_csv(b/"两模型全部自然高分机会.csv",encoding="utf-8-sig")
base=all_events[(all_events.era=="2024—2025")&(all_events.model!="服务建筑十变量")]
assert len(base)==9 and base.model.nunique()==1
new_dates=set(m["primary_new_natural_high_score_dates"])
old_dates=set(base.signal_date)
assert len(d)==13 and len(new_dates)==4 and old_dates.issubset(set(d.signal_date))
assert set(d.signal_date)-old_dates==new_dates
extra=d[d.signal_date.isin(new_dates)].copy()
signed=float(extra.net_event_return.sum())
max_row=extra.loc[extra.net_event_return.idxmax()]
remaining=float(signed-max_row.net_event_return)
obj={
 "at":datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat(),"experiment_id":"E57",
 "status":"COMPLETED_ALL_13_OPPORTUNITIES_PRESERVED_ADDED_4_CONTRIBUTION_DESCRIPTION_ONLY",
 "all_13_kept":True,"old_9_original_dates_all_kept":True,"removed_original_dates":[],
 "new_4_natural_dates":sorted(new_dates),
 "new_4_arithmetic_net_return_sum":signed,"largest_new_event":{"decision_date":str(max_row.signal_date),"entry_date":str(max_row.entry_date),"exit_date":str(max_row.exit_date),"net_return":float(max_row.net_event_return)},
 "remaining_3_arithmetic_net_return_sum":remaining,
 "largest_new_event_share_of_signed_new_4_sum":float(max_row.net_event_return/signed),
 "caution":"带符号合计会因正负抵消超过100%；这是保存原机会的算术贡献描述，非完整账户收益、收益贡献因果或新四笔策略。四笔由已完成原模型结果得到，不能作为事前筛选，也不删除原九笔重训。",
 "all_13_net_mean":float(d.net_event_return.mean()),"original_rejection_preserved":True,
 "new_model_fits":0,"new_labels":0,"new_accounts":0,"new_network_requests":0,"source_code_edits":0,
 "net_sharpe":"NOT_COMPUTED","goal_achieved":False
}
save("全部13保留_新增4机会贡献仅描述.json",obj)
proposal={
 "experiment_id":"E59","status":"PROPOSED_FULL_ORIGINAL_MONTH_OFFICIAL_JOINT_CAUSE_INFORMATION_NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN",
 "created_at":datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat(),
 "different_question":"全原月份中同时存在的公开共同原因，能否提供区别于PMI水平与行业订单值的历史状态信息；不同公开原因并存，不将相同数值或单次正收益自动分为可交易状态。",
 "why_next":"E54只两后验目标月的官方整体共同解释，E56两项行业需求水平树已冻结失败；下一先完善原因本身的来源，不继续在该树改列、持有期、费用、门槛或选近期/岭模型救结果。",
 "scope":"从原全部1711当前/成熟成员及原1212评分日反查需要的统计月，预计2018-11—2025-12共86月，以实际原绑定为准；保留全部原身份，不以两个月或新增四机会确定样本。",
 "first_concrete_action":"先核E38/E54既有五个月官方解释的字段与引用层级，并按原月母集建立明确共同原因/同期背景/未知矩阵；再登记实际剩余原官方来源路线与有限收件预算。未建立合法来源时不开展模型。",
 "source_definition":"只保存官方明确作用对象及多项共同理由；制造业整体PMI解释不得当作生产单项降幅权重；需求不足、天气季节、前期基数、外部变化可并存，不默认天气/关税二选一，也不把未提及原因记为0。",
 "clock":"原显示/元数据公布时间与收件版本分开；原因只能在原决定时已公开才作为可知信息，首次版本未认证保留UNKNOWN；不能由事后行情或政策回填。",
 "reuse_stop":"旧E38采购三个月来源用途、E51/E56模型拒绝与E33/E58无金额事实均保持；需要实质新、全母集支持的原因信息才另登记模型。不新增人工盈利原因标签，不切掉缺失月份，不挑盈利叶或改主模型。",
 "model_budget":0,"new_return_label_budget":0,"account_budget":0,"source_code_edit_budget":0,
 "network_budget_current_proposal":0,"network_note":"具体尚未登记，不自动派出86个月网络采集；下一先原完整母集与已有来源合同，实际新收件预算须另有可复核登记。",
 "registered":False,"run":False,"market_expectation_surprise":"UNKNOWN","causal_stock_return":"NOT_IDENTIFIED",
 "source_panel_full_original_members":"NOT_ESTABLISHED","net_sharpe":"NOT_COMPUTED","goal_achieved":False,
 "current_view":"NO_VIEW","position":"UNSET","orders_authorized":False,
 "specific_DR_access_dependency_unchanged":True,"root_impasse_proven":False
}
save("next_experiment.json",proposal)
print(json.dumps({"E57_added_contribution":obj,"next":proposal["status"]},ensure_ascii=False))
